Name: Penny Ever After - Marriage Dialogue Expansion
Author: RacingRabbit
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/zh7pnpbm/overview-4.png[/img]

I love Stardew, but I've always found the marriage aspect to be underdeveloped. Spousal dialogue starts repeating super quickly, which breaks the immersion for me. Penny arguably suffers the most due to her heavy job schedule - players see the same two options in the morning and evening for half the week.

This mod aims to fix that, adding 5000+ new lines of randomized dialogue across all the regular marriage keys, plus post-marriage festival, ginger island, pregnancy, and gifting dialogue. Most of these lines are [b]grouped by season[/b], to improve immersion. The mod also uses game state queries to make Penny more aware of time, your farm’s specific crops/animals, and other dynamic conditions.

Overall, I think the lines deepen Penny's character post-marriage, making her feel more real, playful, and deeply in love.

Working on this has consumed most of my free time over the past 8 months, so I hope it's useful to others! If you're interested in a similar mod I made for [b]Haley[/b], please [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28046]click here[/url].

[img]https://i.ibb.co/V0dDn8WV/features-5.png[/img]
[color=#e69138][size=4]
[/size][/color][b][color=#e69138][size=4]THREE SPICE LEVELS:[/size][/color]
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Sweet[/b] (5,000+ lines): The SFW base, with references to kissing/cuddling and only indirect references to anything beyond that. Recommended if you want a very similar vibe to the vanilla game, but with more romance.
[*][b]Mature[/b] (adds 1,000+ NSFW lines to the Sweet pool): The default config. These lines are mostly what I consider tasteful intimacy, with references to "making love" etc.
[*][b]Extra Spicy[/b] (adds 250 lines to the Mature + Sweet pool): This dialogue is less tasteful and there's some (rare) bad language. You've been warned! :)
[/list]All spice options include some dialogue that is unique to female and male players.
[color=#e69138][size=4][b]
CANON FRIENDLY: [/b][/size][/color]I've tried my very best to capture Penny's gentle, thoughtful, and a little shy voice. But expect her to be increasingly confident and playful in the safety of her marriage. There's a lot of references to her backstory, previous events in the game, Stardew lore, and her relationships with other Stardew characters.

[size=4][b][color=#e69138]GAME STATE AWARENESS:[/color] [/b][/size]For a more dynamic experience, this mod makes extensive use of game state queries, including some built with custom code. This means Penny's lines can reflect changing conditions. So, for example, Penny might reference the[b] specific crops[/b] you're growing (or not growing), [b]specific animals[/b] you have right now, whether you have kids or not yet, [b]how long you've been married[/b], how much money you have, whether you have a slime hutch, or a [b]fairy trinket[/b] enabled etc.

[color=#e69138][b][size=4]FESTIVALS: [/size][/b][/color]Includes sequential, non-repeating post-marriage festival dialogue for Penny from [b]Year 2 to Year 20[/b]. Can be disabled in config.

[color=#e69138][size=4][b]ENHANCED GIFTING: [/b][/size][/color]750+ lines of randomized[b] gift acceptance dialogue for Penny[/b], for her loved gifts, plus loved birthday gifts. Loved gifts for Penny include: melon, poppy, emerald, diamond, any book, roots platter, red plate, sandfish, tom kha soup, poppyseed muffin, prismatic shard, pearl, magic rock candy, golden pumpkin, and stardrop tea. Penny also gifts the player [b]a more varied range of items[/b] with specifically tailored dialogue.

[b][color=#e69138][size=4]GINGER ISLAND RESORT: [/size][/color][/b]300+ lines of randomized post-marriage [b]resort dialogue[/b] for Penny.

[color=#e69138][size=4][b]RAINY DAY BUG FIX:[/b][/size][/color] [b]Patches a bug in the vanilla code[/b] where Penny would still go to the museum to teach Jas and Vincent on rainy days (and the 9th of 23rd of each season) even though the children don't attend class on those days. Penny stays home instead.

[b][color=#e69138][size=4]PREGNANCY/ADOPTION DIALOGUE:[/size][/color][/b] Includes a pool of randomized lines that may play in the morning or evening[b] during the 14 days Penny is pregnant or you are awaiting the arrival of an adopted child.[/b] This dialogue won't appear on all days, and will be more reliable in the evenings.  It does not override the vanilla game's dialogue for these events, it's in addition.

[b][color=#e69138][size=4]ENHANCED TOWN DIALOGUE:[/size][/color][/b] 200+ town-based lines. Covers Penny teaching at the museum, plus expanded Monday town dialogue, including [b]new interactions[/b] under the tree near the river, and expanded dialogue in Pierre’s and on the bench with Maru.

[color=#e69138][size=4][b]DATE SPECIFIC LINES:[/b][/size][/color] Includes a large pool of date specific lines that are structured to appear on important days (e.g. before and after[b] Penny's birthday, and around festivals[/b]). This dialogue will play [b]sequentially through the years by default[/b], to reduce any chance of repetition. It can be changed to "randomized" in config, and I recommend that if you're playing with this mod more than once.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/k6m0bB2Y/requirements-3.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Content Patcher 2.4.0 or above
[*]SMAPI
[/list]This mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6, and has been tested extensively on the latest build, 1.6.15. It's [b]fine to install this mod if you're already married[/b] to Penny.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Z1mgfXPY/installation-3.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Download the .zip file. Ensure you have Content Patcher and SMAPI installed.
[*]Extract the contents of the .zip file to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods (or wherever you keep your mods)
[*]That's it, you're good to go. If you need to remove the mod in the future just delete it again from your mods folder. You can add and remove at will, it won't affect your save.
[/list]Spice level and other options can be set either by using the Generic Mod Config Menu on startup (if installed) or by manually editing the config.json file. The three spice settings if you're entering manually are: Sweet, Mature, ExtraSpicy.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/vvCCQDzp/compatibility-3.png[/img]

Penny Ever After plays nice with almost all other mods as it only makes changes to Penny's marriage dialogue and some slight tweaks to her marriage schedule. It[b] works fine with major expansions like SVE[/b], and I've also tested it extensively with the Canon Friendly Dialogue mod. It should work fine with all portrait mods and event mods (like Date Night, Date Night Redux, Miihau's Penny Event Expansion etc). Mods that focus on Penny's marriage dialogue are likely to be overridden by this mod and are not compatible. If you have compatibility questions, please ask in the comments.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/BVwM9wF6/translations-2.png[/img]

Translations are welcome and don’t require permission. Since it’s a big project, it might be worth mentioning your plans in the comments, though, to avoid duplication.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Kpcr8f7w/future-plans-3.png[/img]

I'd like to add some heart-based marriage events for Penny, more gifting dialogue (for liked items), and support for non-binary players. I'm currently working on Abigail Ever After, and a pre-marriage prequel to Haley Ever After. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/PZXRT6HG/disclaimers-3.png[/img]

While I've tried to include a ton of options for each dialogue key, the way that randomization works means that if you play long enough, you'll probably see some repetition at some point. It's not infinite. Mature/Extra Spicy content is intended for adult audiences.[b][color=#ffe599][size=4][center][/center][/size][/color][/b]
